headline: Light Sunday: 12 selections cleared the price bar and 8 were cut on news or role, leaving four plays and one two-leg parlay for 4 units. Nothing in the London game (PHI @ JAX): its best edge, Will Shipley to score, was under the bar.

games.note: No play. Nothing cleared the bar: Will Shipley TD (+4.4%, with Barkley out) and the over 41.5 (+1.7%, Pinnacle moving toward the over) came closest.

No play. Dohnte Meyers TD showed +12.6% but it depends on Ja'Marr Chase (concussion protocol) and Tee Higgins (adductor), both questionable until the 11:30 AM ET inactives. Greg Dulcich under cut: tight end Justin Joly is out, which moves Dulcich up.

picks.subject: Rachaad White
picks.label: Rachaad White under 25.5 rush yds
picks.reason: Pinnacle's line is 23.5 and DraftKings is still at 25.5: White is back from a shoulder injury after three limited practices and is expected to rotate with Ekeler while Croskey-Merritt, also cleared, takes most of the carries and Jayden Daniels returns at quarterback.

picks.subject: Oronde Gadsden II
picks.label: Oronde Gadsden II anytime TD
picks.reason: McConkey is not expected to play (reported this morning), Johnston and Thompson are out and Njoku is on IR, so Gadsden is one of the few healthy Chargers targets; Pinnacle's fair price is +310 and DraftKings is at +340.

picks.subject: Omarion Hampton
picks.label: Omarion Hampton under 42.5 rush yds
picks.reason: Pinnacle's line is 37.5 against DraftKings' 42.5: four Chargers linemen are out (Slater, Alt, Penning, Awosika) and Hampton had 9 carries last week in a three-way split with Keaton Mitchell and Vidal; half a unit because the fair price is stretched across five yards.

picks.subject: AJ Barner
picks.label: AJ Barner anytime TD
picks.reason: Barner is healthy and is Seattle's sneak man at the goal line (he already has a rushing touchdown this season); DraftKings' +340 is longer than Pinnacle's fair +317, an edge that clears the bar only narrowly.

picks.label: Parlay: Rachaad White under 25.5 rush yds + Oronde Gadsden II anytime TD
picks.reason: The two best-supported plays, from different games; DraftKings pays about +729 for the pair against a fair +613.

passed.label: Tyler Huntley anytime TD +450 (+13.9%)
passed.why: Edge over 10% with no news behind it: Jackson was ruled out Friday and Huntley has been the known starter since.

passed.label: Dohnte Meyers anytime TD +320 (+12.6%)
passed.why: His role depends on Chase (concussion protocol) and Higgins (adductor), both questionable and unresolved.

passed.label: DeMario Douglas anytime TD +360 (+10.9%)
passed.why: Edge over 10% with no fresh news: Hollins has been out since Friday, and Douglas has no touchdowns and 82 yards on 17 targets.

passed.label: Sam Darnold anytime TD +950 (+9.1%)
passed.why: Pocket passer; Seattle's goal-line sneaks go to AJ Barner.

passed.label: Terry McLaurin anytime TD +235 (+8.1%)
passed.why: Questionable, limited only on Friday, game-time decision.

passed.label: Daniel Jones anytime TD +700 (+7.1%)
passed.why: Thin running role after surgery; last week's score was his first rushing touchdown in almost a year.

passed.label: Justin Herbert under 25.5 rush yds (+5.9%)
passed.why: Four linemen out points to more scrambles, and Pinnacle's line is only one yard lower.

passed.label: Greg Dulcich under 28.5 rec yds (+4.9%)
passed.why: Tight end Justin Joly is out, so Dulcich's role grows; DraftKings' higher number fits that.

notes: Built at about 8:20 AM ET, before inactives for every game. Skip the White under (and the parlay) if Croskey-Merritt is a surprise inactive at 11:30 AM ET, since White's role would grow. Skip the Hampton under if Keaton Mitchell is inactive (2:35 PM ET list). Later runs re-check these.
The parlay shares both legs with the singles, so the White under and the Gadsden touchdown each count on two tickets.
To settle by hand: Tyler Goodson anytime TD +700, 1u (TB @ DAL, Thursday, id 8375e980). He is not in the box score: void if he did not play, a loss if he played.

late_checks.note: 11:45 AM ET, after the 11:30 inactives: White, Croskey-Merritt, Ekeler, McLaurin and Daniels are all active (Washington's inactives are Diggs, Mariota, Owens, Cross, Butler, Togiai, Omenihu), so the White under holds. Rain with wind near 14 mph in Landover; not a reason to drop a rushing under for a rotation back. Props are not re-priced.

3:05 PM ET, after both inactive lists. DEN @ LAC: Ladd McConkey is a surprise active (Chargers inactives are Johnston, James, Shelley, D. Jackson, Awosika, Alt, Thompson), but he did not practice all week and CBS's tracker says he is not expected to play meaningful snaps, so the Gadsden touchdown is held; treat it as a thinner edge than this morning if McConkey turns out to play a normal role. Keaton Mitchell is active and Alt and Awosika are out with Slater and Penning on IR, so the Hampton under holds. SF @ SEA: Barner is active (Seattle's inactives are Milroe, R. Henry, Surratt, Foster and tight end Kallerup); dry with light wind in Seattle. SoFi is roofed. Props are not re-priced; no game-line plays, so no odds request.
